environment: Node.js full application VM with shared DOM stub
limitations: Not browser visual-layout, native input, focus, or animation scheduling QA.

results.name: Legacy unbound entity opens without adding an animation binding
Studio placement uses scene entity defaults and selected live identity
Named state assignments and defaults update the selected entity
Removing the default state chooses the remaining valid state
Initial play logs ordered entry markers once and honors frame durations
Pause and resume do not replay an entered frame marker
Loop boundary re-enters frame zero at the complete animation duration
Nonloop preview holds its final pose and stops at the exact end
Restart preserves active playback and re-enters the initial frame
Scrubbing is silent and stepping advances one 60 Hz tick
Animation duration edits cancel playback and restart the preview safely
Deleting an animation cancels playback and exposes a repairable reference
Deleting the selected entity stops playback and clears the selected identity
Missing artwork prevents playback while preserving the assigned state
Missing artwork reached during playback keeps its frame selected for repair
Changing tabs cancels playback and preserves every authored binding
Browser visibility state prevents hidden preview playback
Opening another scene entity switches scene and selection by stable IDs
Preview facing mirrors actual draw calls for both tile art and contact boxes without editing defaults
Animation preview callbacks convert elapsed milliseconds to 60 Hz ticks
Scene entity properties expose the entry point to Entity Studio
Studio entry-event preview never invokes audio or gameplay callbacks
Integrated Entity Studio handlers report no unexpected application errors
